propositions: Author-facing guides currently describe Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria as a real distinction for containers, but this vocabulary split is being removed from the codebase.
The guides must be rewritten to describe container requirements in terms of decomposition/coverage and testing deferral rather than the now-obsolete Success Criteria heading.
The leaf-vs-container section rule must be re-expressed so containers are still distinguishable from leaves (coverage requirement, child decomposition, deferred testing) rather than becoming vacuous.

The rewrite must ensure no Success Criteria vocabulary remains in three specific documentation files while preserving four permanent carve-outs in the codebase (T2 pilot metrics, dod_uncertifiable concept).
